source_label: BKK Thai Takeaway's own menu PDF (bkkthaitakeaway.co.uk)
pricing_notes: Soups: choose your protein — prawns or squid £6.80, chicken £6.50, mushrooms, tofu or vegetables £5.00.

Rad Kaw dishes are served over steamed jasmine rice: vegetables or tofu £11.00, chicken or pork £11.95, beef, prawn, squid, crispy chicken or crispy belly pork £12.95, duck £13.50; add a fried egg +£1.50.
Curries: tofu or vegetables £8.95, chicken or pork £10.00, beef, prawn, squid, crispy chicken or crispy belly pork £11.00, duck £12.00; rice not included.
Noodle & rice dishes: tofu or vegetables £10.00, chicken or pork £12.50, prawn or beef £13.50.
Some dishes can be made gluten free or vegan — please speak to staff when ordering.

Gin Len (Snacks).name: Pork Meatball Skewers
Gin Len (Snacks).description: Homemade lightly peppered pork meatball skewers, dipped in sauce. Choose your sauce: spicy or non-spicy coriander & sweet basil.

Gin Len (Snacks).name: Fresh Thai Fish Cakes
Gin Len (Snacks).description: With sweet cucumber relish and crushed peanuts.

Gin Len (Snacks).name: The Wings
Gin Len (Snacks).description: Chef's special — choose sticky sauce, salt 'n' pepper, or garlic, ginger & coriander.

Gin Len (Snacks).name: The Ribs (Pork)
Gin Len (Snacks).description: Chef's special — choose sticky sauce, salt 'n' pepper, or garlic, ginger & coriander.

Gin Len (Snacks).name: Crispy Rolls with Sweet Chilli Dip
Gin Len (Snacks).description: Choose: vegetable spring rolls £6.50, duck spring rolls £7.00, or prawn rolls £6.95.

Gin Len (Snacks).name: Gin Len Mixed
Gin Len (Snacks).description: A mixed combination of Chef's Special sauce spare ribs, prawn and chicken toasts, vegetable spring rolls and chicken satay.

Soups.name: Clear Tom Yam
Soups.description: A clear, refreshing broth featuring tomatoes and mushrooms, infused with fresh lemongrass, galangal, chillies and kaffir lime leaves, finished with spring onions and coriander.

Soups.name: Silky Tom Yam
Soups.description: A rich, vibrant broth featuring tomatoes and mushrooms, infused with fresh lemongrass, chilli paste, galangal and kaffir lime leaves, finished with a dash of evaporated milk and fresh spring onions and coriander.

Soups.name: Coco Kah
Soups.description: A luscious, coconut-based broth simmered with fresh lemongrass, galangal and kaffir lime, with mushrooms and tomatoes for a silky finish, elevated with fresh and dried chillies, spring onions and coriander.

Soups.name: The Ocean's Flare
Soups.description: A fiery clear soup with prawns, squid and mussels, elevated with fresh holy basil and crispy dried chillies, topped with spring onions and coriander.

Thai Salads.name: Larb
Thai Salads.description: Fresh and zesty Thai salad tossed with lime juice, roasted rice powder, chilli and fresh herbs. Choose: minced chicken, minced pork or grilled pork £9.95, minced beef £10.50, minced duck £12.50.

Thai Salads.name: Nam Tok
Thai Salads.description: Grilled meat tossed with lime juice, roasted rice powder, chilli and fresh herbs. Choose grilled pork £9.95 or grilled beef £10.50.

Thai Salads.name: Plah
Thai Salads.description: Fresh and zesty Thai salad tossed with lime juice, chilli, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, shallot, chilli paste and fresh herbs. Choose beef £10.50, or prawn / glass noodle with minced pork & prawn £11.50.

Thai Salads.name: Yam
Thai Salads.description: Fresh and zesty Thai salad tossed with lime juice, celery and fresh chilli. Choose grilled pork £9.95, grilled beef £10.50 or seafood £11.50.

Thai Salads.name: Som Tam Thai
Thai Salads.description: Shredded green papaya tossed with lime juice, palm sugar, fish sauce, tomatoes, peanuts and chilli. Add grilled chicken +£5.00.

Rad Kaw (served over rice).name: The Holy Basil POW
Rad Kaw (served over rice).description: A Thai holy basil stir-fry with chilli and garlic, bold and aromatic. (Not available for minced meats.)

Rad Kaw (served over rice).name: Cha Cha Fingerroot Stir-Fry
Rad Kaw (served over rice).description: A bold Thai herb stir-fry infused with fingerroot, fresh green peppercorns, fine beans, kaffir lime leaves and chilli. (Not available for minced meats.)

Rad Kaw (served over rice).name: The Sweet (not) Hora Pa
Rad Kaw (served over rice).description: Spicy Thai sweet basil stir-fry with red chillies, bamboo shoots and flowing heat. (Not available for minced meats.)

Rad Kaw (served over rice).name: Silky Chilli Paste Stir-Fry
Rad Kaw (served over rice).description: Thai chilli paste stir-fry with carrot, mushroom, sweet basil leaves, turmeric powder, onion, spring onion, broccoli and peppers. (Not available for minced meats.)

Rad Kaw (served over rice).name: Ginger Snap
Rad Kaw (served over rice).description: Ginger stir-fry with black wood ear mushrooms, spring onion, onion, carrot and red chillies.

Rad Kaw (served over rice).name: Garlic & Pepper Stir-Fry (Pad Gra Tiem Prik Thai)
Rad Kaw (served over rice).description: Stir-fry with garlic, white pepper and coriander roots, topped with crispy garlic. (Not available for minced meats.)

Rad Kaw (served over rice).name: Oyster Edge
Rad Kaw (served over rice).description: A savoury oyster sauce stir-fry with mushrooms, spring onion, onion, fresh baby corn, carrot and broccoli.

Rad Kaw (served over rice).name: The Sweet Meets The Sour
Rad Kaw (served over rice).description: A cheerful stir-fry where cucumber, tomato, bell peppers, spring onion, onion, carrot and pineapple come together in perfect harmony.

Curries.name: Green Curry
Curries.description: Green curry with peppers, aubergine, bamboo shoot and sweet basil.

Curries.name: Red Curry
Curries.description: Red curry with peppers, aubergine, bamboo shoot and sweet basil.

Curries.name: Jungle Curry
Curries.description: A broth-based jungle curry cooked with fingerroot, kaffir lime leaves, chillies, bamboo shoots, roasted rice powder, courgette, aubergine, green peppercorns, fine bean, baby corn and Thai holy basil.

Curries.name: Pa Neng
Curries.description: A distinctive Paneng curry, rich and thick rather than saucy, finished with sliced chillies, sweet basil leaves and fragrant kaffir lime leaves.

Curries.name: Massaman
Curries.description: A luxurious Massaman curry with peanut, potato, carrot and onion, delicately scented with star anise and cinnamon sticks, topped with fried shallots.

Curries.name: Yellow Curry
Curries.description: A mild curry with potato, carrot, onion, turmeric powder and curry powder, topped with fried shallots.

BKK Signatures.name: Crispy Duck Tamarind
BKK Signatures.description: Golden crispy duck glazed in a rich tamarind sauce, with a perfect balance of sweet and tangy notes, topped with crispy shallot and cashew nuts. Rice not included.

BKK Signatures.name: Kaw Soi Chicken Thigh
BKK Signatures.description: Northern Thai coconut curry noodle soup with chicken thigh and egg noodles in a rich, aromatic curry broth, sprinkled with crispy noodles, crispy chilli and fried shallots, served with pickled mustard greens, shallots, lime and coriander.

BKK Signatures.name: Grilled Chicken Tamarind
BKK Signatures.description: Grilled chicken glazed in a rich tamarind sauce, with a perfect balance of sweet and tangy notes, topped with crispy shallot and cashew nuts. Rice not included.

BKK Signatures.name: Chicken Cashew Clash
BKK Signatures.description: Lightly battered chicken stir-fried with onions, fresh baby corn, mushroom, peppers, spring onions and roasted cashew nuts, finished with a savoury sauce and lightly sprinkled with crispy fried chilli. Rice not included.

BKK Local.name: Bowl Noodle Yentafo
BKK Local.description: Wide rice noodles in Yentafo sauce with squid, pork, prawn, fish balls, white fungus mushrooms, water spinach and beansprouts, finished with a gentle hint of chilli and topped with fried garlic, coriander and spring onions. (The broth is packed separately for best quality.)

BKK Local.name: Bowl Noodle Peanut Tom Yam
BKK Local.description: Thin rice noodles in tom yum broth with ground peanuts, minced pork, sliced pork, fish balls, homemade pork meatballs, beansprouts, chilli and lime, finished with fried garlic, coriander and spring onions. (The broth is packed separately for best quality.)

BKK Local.name: Bowl Noodle Char Siu & Wonton
BKK Local.description: Fresh egg noodles served with sliced char siu pork and pork wontons, drizzled with a lightly sweet honey and spice char siu sauce, finished with aromatic fried garlic, coriander and spring onion. (The broth is packed separately for best quality.)

BKK Local.name: Bowl Noodle Braised Beef & Tendon
BKK Local.description: Vermicelli in beef broth with braised beef and beef tendon, beansprouts, celery and Thai sweet basil, topped with fried garlic and spring onions; chilli vinegar packed separately on the side. (The broth is packed separately for best quality.)

BKK Local.name: Fruity Red Duck Curry
BKK Local.description: Duck in a fragrant red curry balanced with lychee, tomato, grapes and pineapple, finished with Thai holy basil for a sweet and spicy harmony. Rice not included.

BKK Local.name: Chilli Water Spinach
BKK Local.description: Water spinach with fresh chillies, garlic, yellow bean paste and oyster sauce. Rice not included.

BKK Local.name: Som Tam Pla Rar
BKK Local.description: Thai green papaya salad tossed with fermented fish sauce and salted crab, mixed with fresh chillies, fine bean, lime juice and tomatoes.

Seabass.name: Crispy Seabass Mango
Seabass.description: Crispy seabass fillet topped with mango salad, tossed with fresh chillies, coriander, carrot, lime juice, shallots, spring onions and fish sauce for a bold sweet, sour and spicy kick. Crispy seabass packed separately to maintain crispiness; rice not included.

Seabass.name: Crispy Seabass Herbal Crunch
Seabass.description: Crispy seabass fillet topped with finely diced aromatic herbs — shallots, ginger, lemongrass, garlic, galangal, fresh chillies, crunchy peanuts and lime — for a fragrant, zesty and spicy finish.

Seabass.name: Seabass Lime Juice
Seabass.description: Steamed seabass with lime, fresh chillies, garlic, pickled garlic and coriander.

Seabass.name: Seabass Ginger
Seabass.description: Steamed seabass fillet with fragrant ginger, light soy sauce, coriander, celery and sliced chillies for a clean, aromatic finish. (Can be made gluten free upon request.)

Seabass.name: Fried Fish Sweet Basil Blaze
Seabass.description: Fried seabass fillet topped with a chilli, garlic and sweet basil sauce.

Seabass.name: Fried Fish 3 Flavoured
Seabass.description: Fried seabass fillet tossed in a vibrant sweet, sour and savoury sauce, stir-fried with diced onions, peppers, pineapple, tomatoes and spring onions.

Seabass.name: Fried Fish Cha Cha Fingerroot
Seabass.description: Fried seabass fillet tossed with a Thai herb stir-fry infused with aromatic fingerroot, fresh green peppercorns, fine beans, kaffir lime leaves and chilli. (Can be made gluten free upon request.)

Rice & Noodles.name: Singapore Vermicelli with Chicken & Prawn
Rice & Noodles.description: Singapore vermicelli stir-fry with chicken, prawn, tofu, beansprouts and garlic chives.

Rice & Noodles.name: Pink Coconut Blush Vermicelli with Prawn
Rice & Noodles.description: Singapore vermicelli stir-fry with prawn, tofu, beansprouts and garlic chives, finished with soft coconut creaminess and a gentle tamarind tang.

Rice & Noodles.name: Crispy Chicken Chow Mein (Egg Noodles)
Rice & Noodles.description: Chow mein with savoury preserved radish, egg, garlic and white pepper, sprinkled with chopped spring onions.

Rice & Noodles.name: Guay Tiew Kua Gai
Rice & Noodles.description: Stir-fried noodles with chicken, egg, garlic and white pepper, sprinkled with chopped spring onions.

Rice & Noodles.name: Drunken Noodle
Rice & Noodles.description: Drunken noodles stir-fried with chilli, fine beans, spring green, carrot, bamboo shoots, fresh baby corn, mushrooms, peppers, fingerroot, fresh peppercorn, kaffir lime leaves and holy basil. Choose rice ribbon or fresh udon noodle; chicken or pork £12.50, prawn or beef £13.50, tofu or vegetables £10.00.

Rice & Noodles.name: Pad Si Ew Noodle
Rice & Noodles.description: Stir-fried rice noodles with egg, spring green, carrot, seasoned with garlic and white pepper in a savoury soy sauce. Choose rice ribbon noodle or rice vermicelli; chicken or pork £12.50, prawn or beef £13.50, tofu or vegetables £10.00.

Rice & Noodles.name: Pad Thai Noodle
Rice & Noodles.description: Pad Thai rice noodles with eggs, beansprouts and garlic chives, served with crushed peanuts and lime. Choose your protein: chicken or pork £12.50, prawn or beef £13.50, tofu or vegetables £10.00.

Rice & Noodles.name: BKK Fried Rice
Rice & Noodles.description: Classic egg fried rice tossed with onion, spring onion and tomato. Choose your protein: chicken or pork £12.50, prawn or beef £13.50, tofu or vegetables £10.00.

Rice & Noodles.name: Tropical Pineapple Rice
Rice & Noodles.description: A lightly spiced pineapple fried rice with chicken and prawn, tossed with cashew nut, tomato, raisin, onion, green peas and carrots, gently seasoned with curry powder.

Rice & Noodles.name: Tom Yam Egg Fried Rice
Rice & Noodles.description: Tom yam egg fried rice with prawn, mushrooms and tomato, layered with aromatic herbs and refreshing citrus notes.

Rice & Noodles.name: Minced Beef POW Rice
Rice & Noodles.description: Thai holy basil minced beef fried rice.

Vegan & Gluten Free.name: VGF Gin Len
Vegan & Gluten Free.description: Choose: tofu with sweet chilli and crushed peanut, salt 'n' pepper tofu, or mushroom satay.

Vegan & Gluten Free.name: VGF Soup
Vegan & Gluten Free.description: Choose mushroom, cauliflower, tofu or vegetables with VGF Clear Tom Yam, Coco Kah or The Ocean's Flare.

Vegan & Gluten Free.name: VGF Som Tam Thai
Vegan & Gluten Free.description: Shredded green papaya tossed with lime juice, palm sugar, tomatoes, peanuts and chilli.

Vegan & Gluten Free.name: VGF Rad Kaw
Vegan & Gluten Free.description: Served over steamed Thai jasmine rice; spice level can be adjusted and tofu can be added upon request.

Vegan & Gluten Free.name: VGF Rice & Noodles
Vegan & Gluten Free.description: Choose: Pad Thai, Holy Basil POW, Sweet (not) Hora Pa, Cha Cha Fingerroot, Ginger Snap, Oyster Edge, The Sweet Meets The Sour, POW Rice, BKK Fried Rice, Tropical Pineapple Rice, or Drunken Noodle (rice ribbon or fresh udon).
